title: One button per person — and it always says who the contract is waiting for

steps.do: As Test BranchMgr open the won quotation → Contract.
steps.expect: "Contract waiting for approval." No main button. It reads "Waiting for the first signature — <names>. Then the final approval — <names>." and, in bold, "You give the final approval, after the first signature. (You can give the first signature instead — but then someone else must give the final approval.)" with a quiet button "Give the first signature instead".
steps.observed: Panel: "Give the first signature instead Reject Waiting for the first signature — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test Director and 3 more. Then the final approval — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test BranchMgr2. You give the final approval, after the first signature. (You can " — buttons [Give the first signature instead, Reject], the first-signature one quiet (btn small secondary).
steps.note: A "Reject" button is also shown beside the quiet first-signature button.

steps.do: As Test Finance (signs nothing) open the same quotation.
steps.expect: No buttons at all — only who it is waiting for.
steps.observed: No buttons; only "Waiting for the first signature — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test Director and 3 more. Then the final approval — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test BranchMgr2.".

steps.do: As Test OpsMgr → /contract-openings → "Give the first signature".
steps.expect: "First signature given. Waiting for the final approval — <Branch Managers by name>."
steps.observed: "First signature given. Waiting for the final approval — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test BranchMgr2."

steps.expect: One main button: "Approve & open the contract". Press it → contract OPEN.
steps.observed: One main button "Approve & open the contract" (plus Reject); pressed → "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001 opened and floated to operations."

steps.do: New Pending contract. As Test BranchMgr press "Give the first signature instead".
steps.expect: "First signature given. Waiting for the final approval — <the OTHER Branch Manager>" — their own name is not in the list.
steps.observed: "First signature given. Waiting for the final approval — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr2." — Test BranchMgr's own name is not in the list.
steps.note: The test speaks of "the OTHER Branch Manager"; the list also names Test BAM (Branch Application Manager), who may give the final approval under the standard rule.

steps.do: Still as Test BranchMgr look at it again.
steps.expect: No Approve button: "You gave the first signature, so the final approval must come from someone else."
steps.observed: No Approve button; the panel says "You gave the first signature, so the final approval must come from someone else."

steps.do: (Careful testers) Re-send an old "approve" form as Test BranchMgr.
steps.expect: Refused with the same sentence; the contract stays Pending.
steps.observed: Refused: "You gave the first signature, so the final approval must come from someone else. First signature given. Waiting for the final approval — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr2."; the contract stays Pending.

steps.do: Admin → Approvals → Sales → Contract: "may one person give both?" = Yes → Save. Repeat the last two steps on a new contract.
steps.expect: After giving the first signature the same person is offered "Approve & open the contract", and it opens.
steps.observed: "Saved — With two approvals, may one person give both? → Yes — one person may give both. It applies from now on." Then Test BranchMgr gave the first signature ("Give the first signature") and was offered "Approve & open the contract": "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00003 opened and floated to operations."

steps.do: Set the rule to "One — a single approval". Register a contract.
steps.expect: Message "… waiting for approval. Waiting for approval — <names>." Test OpsMgr sees no button; Test BranchMgr sees "Approve & open the contract".
steps.observed: "Saved — How many approvals does a new contract need before it opens? → One — a single approval. It applies from now on." Registering: "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00004 registered — it is waiting for approval. Waiting for approval — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test BranchMgr2. The order goes to operations once it is open." Test OpsMgr: /contract-openings says "You are not part of the contract-opening approval."; Test BranchMgr: "Approve & open the contract".

steps.do: Set the rule to "None". Register a contract.
steps.expect: Message "Contract … registered and open — your company asks for no approval to open a contract." The order goes to Operations at once.
steps.observed: "Saved — How many approvals does a new contract need before it opens? → None — it opens as soon as it is registered. It applies from now on." Registering: "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00005 registered and open — your company asks for no approval to open a contract. The operations packet was logged (set up e-mail in Settings to send it)." — open at once; Test Coord's dashboard shows it to raise the inspection call.

steps.do: With "None": change the value of that open contract (an amendment).
steps.expect: It still waits for one approval — "It needs one approval, from …" — because it rewrites a contract already in force.
steps.observed: "Amendment requested — value ₹94,400 → ₹1,50,000. It needs one approval, from Branch Manager or Branch Application Manager; until then the contract keeps its current figures. | In force. Within its term and quantity. quantity 0 of 10 used"

steps.expect: "contracts to endorse" / "contracts to approve" count exactly the contracts where that person has a main button — no more, no fewer.
steps.observed: Under the standard rule, with several contracts pending, each signer's dashboard "contracts to endorse / to approve" equals their main buttons on Contract openings: OPERATION_MANAGER 2/0 (buttons 2/0); BRANCH_MANAGER 0/1 (buttons 0/1); BRANCH_MANAGER2 0/2 (buttons 0/2); BRANCH_APP_MANAGER 0/2 (buttons 0/2); BUSINESS_DIRECTOR 2/0 (buttons 2/0); SBU_HEAD 2/0 (buttons 2/0).
steps.note: Checked after putting the two-signature rule back (with one person not allowed to give both), so both kinds of task exist.

steps.do: Put the rule back to the standard one.
steps.observed: Standard rule back ("Today: two signatures — first Operation Manager, Business Unit Head, Admin (legacy), Business Director or anyone who man…"); registering a contract again reads as in SAL-100: "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00008 registered — it is waiting for approval. Waiting for the first signature — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test Direc…".
